description: Benchmark query set for evaluating semantic retrieval against the TerraLens prototype satellite archive.
benchmark_limitation: Small manually defined benchmark; results indicate prototype behavior and are not a production-scale accuracy estimate.

queries.query_text: urban expansion and new construction near river
queries.rationale: Queries peri-urban building construction and roads adjacent to a seasonal waterway.

queries.query_text: water reservoir shoreline drying and lake shrinkage
queries.rationale: Queries reservoir basin surface water fluctuations and drying shoreline dynamics.

queries.query_text: forest road clearing corridor and tree removal
queries.rationale: Queries linear infrastructure cut through dense forest canopy.

queries.query_text: coastal port reclamation and ocean harbor pier
queries.rationale: Queries industrial land reclamation into coastal mudflats and port waterways.

queries.query_text: solar panel farm photovoltaic arrays in desert terrain
queries.rationale: Queries high-density photovoltaic solar array fields installed over arid sands.
